crossRefs.note: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
‘Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.

translations.web: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
translations.bsb: For they are life to those who find them, and health to the whole body.
translations.kjv: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
translations.asv: For they are life unto those that find them, And health to all their flesh.
